name: Balsamic Chicken Drumsticks with Garlic & Parsley Sautéed Carrots

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic and ginger. In a large bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together ½ of the garlic and ginger (save the rest for the carrots), vinegar, honey, soy sauce, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger
9 tbsp balsamic vinegar
9 tbsp honey
4 ½ tbsp soy sauce
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Make a couple cuts in each of the drumsticks. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat. Transfer to a large baking dish, reserving marinade in bowl.
Place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes. Spoon reserved marinade on top of chicken and continue baking until cooked through, about 25 minutes.
Wash and peel carrots. Slice diagonally into ⅔ cm pieces.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add carrots and season with salt and pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until carrots are tender-crisp and slightly browned, 8-10 minutes. If skillet gets too dry, add a little water.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Stir ½ (save the rest for garnishing) into the carrots.
To serve, place carrots on a plate, add drumsticks on top, and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!
